name: com.velvetcompanionai/velvet
title: Velvet Companion AI
description: Read-only facts about Velvet Companion AI, an 18+ AI companion app: companions, prices, rules, FAQ.

tools.name: search_companions
tools.description: Find Velvet companions by art line (anime or photoreal), type, tag or a word in her name, city, bio or personality. Returns short profiles with links.

query.description: A word to look for, e.g. 'goth', 'Berlin', 'gamer'.

line.description: Art line: 'anime' (drawn) or 'photoreal' (looks like a photograph).

tag.description: A tag as shown on her profile, e.g. 'Slow burn'.

limit.description: How many companions to return (1 to 25).

tools.name: get_companion
tools.description: The full public profile of one Velvet companion by id (e.g. 'rue'), with links.

id.description: Her id as returned by search_companions (e.g. 'rue'), or her name.

tools.name: get_pricing
tools.description: What Velvet costs: the free start, what a photo, clip or voice note costs in tokens, token packs, Plus and Premium passes, payment method, and whether anything renews.

tools.name: about_velvet
tools.description: What Velvet is, which 'Velvet' this is, the platform, the rules (adults only, no minors, no real people, no non-consent), privacy and how to contact it.

tools.name: get_faq
tools.description: Search Velvet Companion AI's published FAQ. Returns question and answer pairs (all of them, or only those whose question or answer contains the word you pass) and the URL of the FAQ page. Use it for short factual answers: refunds, privacy, age rules, payments, how photos, clips and voice notes work. For exact prices call get_pricing; for the rules and contact details call about_velvet.

contains.description: Only questions or answers containing this word, e.g. 'refund'.

tools.name: compare_velvet
tools.description: How Velvet compares with a named AI companion app: chat, nude images, voice and video, free start, and who each suits. Competitor notes are dated and carry no prices.

competitor.description: The other app, by key: e.g. 'candy-ai', 'character-ai', 'replika', 'janitor-ai'.

tools.name: list_guides
tools.description: List Velvet Companion AI's published buyer guides and comparison pages, such as the best uncensored AI girlfriend apps, the best NSFW AI chat apps and AI girlfriend apps that accept crypto. Takes no arguments; returns each guide's title, URL and the question it answers. Open a URL to read the guide (add .md for a Markdown copy). For a head-to-head with one named app call compare_velvet instead.
